note: Two layout defects that survived the first museum pass, plus the CDN purge the token bump forces. 1) #galwrap kept `columns:3` from each page's inline <style>; CSS multi-column is independent of display, so setting display:block moved the grid-in-grid one level up instead of removing it and plates rendered 132px wide. 2) The mega-menu's Contact link and its description are two separate children of a two-column grid, so the description was placed in the right-hand column on all 88 content pages in all three languages.
